_what: Phase 1 teacher pins for vLLM 0.30.0 on the RTX 5070 (sm_120, 12 GB). Metadata only: pinned from the Hugging Face API on 2026-09-25 from the Mac (model info, config.json, chat_template.jinja, tokenizer files, safetensors HEADERS by HTTP range). No weights downloaded, no model loaded. VRAM numbers are ESTIMATES from header byte counts and config shapes; the vLLM startup log line 'Maximum concurrency for 2048 tokens per request' is the measurement that replaces them.
_status: dry: prep config, not training data

vram_assumptions.why_0.88: pc/wsl/gpuguard.py stops a job above 11,600 MiB used for 3 samples; vLLM preallocates util x total, and the Windows desktop also holds VRAM. Use 0.88, or give vLLM jobs a guard override.

official.license_evidence: card YAML license: apache-2.0; license_link ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma_4_license serves the plain Apache License 2.0 text

quant.base: google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized (same QAT weights as the LM Studio q4_0 path)
quant.scheme: compressed-tensors pack-quantized W4A16, int4 symmetric, group 32 (Marlin path; vLLM 0.30 MARLIN_SUPPORTED_GROUP_SIZES includes 32)
quant.loaded_breakdown: text linear 6.13 (int4 + bf16 scales) + tied embed 2.01 bf16 + vision embedder 0.10; the checkpoint's separate lm_head copy (2.01) is skipped because vLLM ties it to embed_tokens
alternatives_not_chosen: RedHatAI/gemma-4-12B-it-NVFP4 @ 8965ad1c93dccb43e05e7882d98f2d32c0dd434d: W4A4 NVFP4, same 10.26 GB file, activations also 4-bit (quality risk), sm120 FP4 kernels exist in 0.30
cyankiwi/gemma-4-12B-it-AWQ-INT4 @ ad2d7e521f3eaee492973ab130025e610b216d2c: stored in F32 (11.22 GB), not the QAT weights

kv_est.concurrent_2048_seqs: about 4.7 if vLLM frees KV outside the 1024 window, about 2.5 if not; roughly x2 with --kv-cache-dtype fp8 (untested on this card)

gemma-4-12b.thinking_off: Raw prompt ending '<|turn>model\n<|channel>thought\n<channel|>' (identical to the official template with enable_thinking false; vLLM 0.30 tests/renderers/test_gemma4_chat_template.py asserts that suffix). Chat alternative: omit enable_thinking (template default false) and send no <|think|>.
gemma-4-12b.bos_warning: Gemma 4 tokenizer.json post_processor adds NO <bos> and tokenizer_config has no add_bos_token; the official template emits bos_token itself. transformers >= 5.10 (vLLM 0.30 pin) therefore adds no BOS to a raw /v1/completions prompt. render_prompt.gemma_raw() has no '<bos>', so under vLLM the prompt starts without BOS (llama.cpp/LM Studio adds it from GGUF metadata). Prefix '<bos>' for vLLM and confirm with POST /tokenize that ids[0] == 2 exactly once.
gemma-4-12b.detect_thinking: request skip_special_tokens false (vLLM default true would hide <|channel> id 100 / <channel|> id 101); reject any output containing them

official.license_evidence: card YAML license: apache-2.0 and '## License: Apache 2.0'

ministral-3-8b.serve: vllm serve ~/planck/models/Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512-AWQ-4bit --tokenizer ~/planck/models/Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512-official-tok --tokenizer-mode mistral --config-format hf --load-format safetensors --served-model-name ministral-3-8b-instruct-awq --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --max-model-len 2048 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 --language-model-only --max-num-seqs 64
ministral-3-8b.wire: chat (render_prompt.chat_body); mistral_common does not parse [INST] control strings inside a raw completions prompt
ministral-3-8b.thinking_off: none needed: the Instruct model has no thinking mode (the Reasoning variant is a separate repo). Confirm with skip_special_tokens false that no id 34/35 appears.
ministral-3-8b.system_prompt_warning: the HF chat template injects Mistral's default system prompt (model name, 'Le Chat', today's date) when no system message is sent; chat_body sends a user message only. --tokenizer-mode mistral avoids the HF template; confirm with POST /tokenize on a messages body before the run.
ministral-3-8b.sampling_card: temperature below 0.1 for production; higher is the card's 'experiment' zone

qwen3.5-9b.wire:
chat with chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false} per request (the server default above is a backstop). Raw alternative: '<|im_start|>user
{prompt}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>

</think>

' with stop ['<|im_end|>'].
qwen3.5-9b.thinking_off:
template emits the empty '<think>

</think>

' block when enable_thinking is false. Qwen3.5 does NOT support /think or /no_think soft switches (card). Serve WITHOUT --reasoning-parser so any stray <think> (id 248068, non-special, visible in text) reaches the checker.
